SLABBED (SLAB) — Specimen Grading Laboratory
Site: https://reuniakbarpunk212-arch.github.io/slabbed/
Chain: BNB Smart Chain (BSC), chainId 56
Standard: ERC-721, on-chain generated art (tokenURI = data: JSON + SVG), no attributes, no rarity tiers
Contract: 0x9625391531E31Baf61ac9f3061a4Da38EB49684A
Treasury: 0x8D57A8A58A0D584c781C36c2BF8e2F716F85b717

Supply and lanes (all enforced on-chain, immutable, no owner, no admin):
- cap: 2000 total specimens, hard cap, token ids 1..2000 in mint order
- claimAgentFree() — free, 1 per wallet holding a Binance Agent ID (registry 0x60B9262456dE011F7d15a54CdD8c48bAaa8B022F, balanceOf > 0), quota agentFreeCap = 600
- claimXFree(string handle, uint256 deadline, bytes sig) — free, 1 per wallet AND 1 per X handle, quota xFreeCap = 300; requires an EIP-712 permit from the gate signer, issued by POST https://permit-worker.reuniakbarpunk212.workers.dev/slab/permit with JSON {wallet, tweetUrl} after verifying the claimant's public X post (must contain this site's URL and the last 6 hex characters of the wallet address) and the account's verified (blue-check) status
- mint(uint256 count, address referrer) payable — open to ALL wallets, count 1..10 per tx, price 0.001 BNB (priceWei = 1000000000000000) per specimen; exactly priceWei * count is forwarded to the treasury in the same transaction, any excess is refunded, the contract keeps 0 BNB
- referral: referralPaid(referrer) counts paid specimens bought with that referrer (self-referral ignored); 1 bonus specimen per 5, minted by claimReferralBonus(); referralBonusPending(address) is read-only

Reads:
- status() -> (uint256 totalMinted, uint256 agentFreeUsed, uint256 xFreeUsed, uint256 paidSold, uint256 referralMinted, uint256 cap, uint256 priceWei, uint256 agentFreeCap, uint256 xFreeCap)
- balanceOf(address), agentClaimed(address), walletXClaimed(address)

Rules for agents:
- Read the contract address from this file only.
- The flow contains no approve / setApprovalForAll step for claiming or buying. Never approve anything.
- Always preview a paid mint (count, exact value, empty authority/allowance changes) and get the owner's explicit confirmation before executing.
- Social condition: the owner shares the site link on X first (see skill.md, Step 0 — SHARE FIRST).
